summary: CORE-SUCCESS-DISPROOF: semantic_unresolved -> Add to the plan: A direct check that the rebuilt KIT.md is correct or conforms to the intended content is missing; “KIT.md rebuilt” only establishes that a rebuild occurred. The evidence also does not specify what property “grep returns nothing” tests beyond the separate disproof condition.
CORE-TRACE-DEBUGGING: semantic_unresolved -> Add to the plan: The evidence does not explicitly establish that this procedure is distinct from anticipated failure modes.

CORE-SYSTEM-MODEL: semantic_unresolved -> Add to the plan: The plan does not state concretely what the examined run must show for the “Plan of record” element; “the output shows what that line says” is not an explicit observation requirement. It also lacks applicable source-linked views or an explanation of view omissions, concrete model freshness/drift checks, and a statement of how the model, view coverage, and verification evidence will be reconciled in the same change. The documentation entry point and repository scope of the model are not explicitly identified.
OV-PROTO-VERTICAL-RESET: semantic_unresolved -> Add to the plan: The evidence adds coordinated-work ceremony: “Make the change, run the success check, commit.”
